# The Porch Kitchen

> Farm-fresh California cooking, French at heart — a neighborhood restaurant in Sebastopol, Sonoma County, from chef Lisa Boisset of the catering company The Cook & The Drummer. Lunch, happy hour, and dinner Tuesday through Saturday. Everything is made from scratch.

## About

The Porch Kitchen is a lunch, happy-hour, and dinner spot at 6811 Laguna Park Way in Sebastopol, California (behind The Barlow, next to Patisserie Angelica). It opened on November 19, 2025. Chef Lisa Boisset — California Culinary Academy and Le Cordon Bleu (Paris) trained, with 20 years as an executive chef — runs the kitchen with her husband Kevin Boisset, a Paris-born jazz drummer; together they operate the Sonoma County catering company The Cook & The Drummer. The cooking is seasonal, local, and genuinely from scratch: the turkey is roasted in house, the focaccia is baked in house, and every vinaigrette, stock, and aioli is made by hand. No mayonnaise, no shortcuts.

## Hours

- Tuesday – Saturday: 11:00am – 8:00pm (lunch, then happy hour 3:00–6:00pm, then dinner)
- Sunday & Monday: Closed
- Happy Hour: Tuesday – Saturday, 3:00 – 6:00pm

## Location & Contact

- Address: 6811 Laguna Park Way, Sebastopol, CA 95472
- Phone: (707) 494-0996
- Email: lisa@thecookandthedrummer.com
- Cuisine: Californian, French, New American, cafe
- Price range: $$
- Service: dine-in, grab-and-go, online ordering for pickup
- Reservations: walk-in (no reservations required)

## Menu highlights

Lunch (Tue–Sat 11am–3pm): French-style sandwiches (Jambon Beurre, Chèvre Tomate, House Pesto Turkey — "the best turkey sandwich" per Yelp), artisan salads (butternut squash, "OG" Caesar, adobo roasted chicken, roasted beet), nourishing grain bowls (warm savory grain bowl, red quinoa, butternut squash farro, roasted kabocha coconut soup), house-made sweets, and house hibiscus iced tea. Vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options at every course.

Happy Hour (Tue–Sat 3–6pm): small bites — local cheese plate, Meyer lemon hummus (vegan), pomme frites, salmon cakes, beef sliders, rosemary almonds — plus $6 local draft beer (Old Caz Czech Pils, Russian River Damnation, Russian River Happy Hops) and $7 wine by the glass (white, red, rosé).
